function run(arr: number[], tup: [number, ...string[]], none: string[]) {
  function opt(a: number, b?: string) { return b; }
  function opt2(a?: number, b?: string, c?: boolean) { return c; }
  function req(a: number, b: string) { return b; }
  function one(a?: number) { return a; }
  function rest(a: number, ...r: string[]) { return r; }
  opt(...tup);
  opt2(...tup);
  one(...arr);
  opt(1, ...none, "x");
  rest(...tup);
  return opt(...tup);
}
console.log(run([1], [1, "a"], []));
